bibl.title: "I, Deacon Iohannes, Servant of Michael": A New Look at P. Heid. Inv. Kopt. 682 and a Possible Context for the Heidelberg Magical Archive.
bibl.seg: Iain Gardner & Jay Johnston, "I, Deacon Iohannes, Servant of Michael": A New Look at P. Heid. Inv. Kopt. 682 and a Possible Context for the Heidelberg Magical Archive.
bibl.note: Description. - P. Heid. Inv. Kopt. 682 [= P. Baden V, 137 (= LDAB 99576)]. - The ritual instructions, potency and practice engaged by the artefact. - The colophon and a possible context for this artefact and others in the archives.
